content.title: Here's a Full List of Retailers Open and Closed on Easter 2026, Plus Holiday Hours
content.text: A Complete List of Stores That Will Be Open on Easter 2026Will your favorite retailer or grocery chain be open this Easter? Here's what to know for Sunday, plus holiday hours.April 4, 2026, 11:00 AM CDTDoing some shopping this Easter? Find out which retail chains will be open (and closed) on Sunday, April 5. Brandon Bell / UCG / Getty ImagesCreate your free account or log in to save this articleEaster is here. With it comes all the trimmings, like coloring eggs with the kids, enjoying a meal with loved ones and a visit from good ol' Peter Cottontail.However you plan to spend the April holiday this year, a trip to one of your favorite retailers may be on your to-do list. If that's the case, see below for a complete list of stores open on Easter, along with details on holiday hours. Among them, you'll find retail giants including Walmart, Trader Joe's, Kroger and other popular chains. You'll also find a full list of stores that will be closed in observance of the Christian holiday, including Target, Costco and Aldi.It's important to note that even though the retailers listed below are noted as open (or closed), select locations may have adjusted or modified hours in observance of Easter Sunday.Because of that, it’s essential to confirm local store hours before heading out the door to avoid disappointment if you arrive at your favorite store only to discover that your particular location is closed this Sunday.To ensure you get exactly what you need this Easter, see below for a list of retailers, as well as a link to each of their store locators, so you can check hours, closing times and other relevant details. Stores Open Easter Sunday 2026Ace Hardware: Stores are independently owned and operated. Select stores may be open, others will be closed. Call ahead for store hours or confirm online before going.
